props.title: Denver Wedding Vendors We Recommend | Signet Artists
props.description: These are the photographers, planners, videographers, caterers, florists and venues we'd recommend to our own clients in Denver. The list is short on purpose.

notes._note: The Preferred Vendor List, 2026-09-20, from the vendor-network handoff as Daniel ruled on it the same day. The name is his ('Preferred Vendor List'). The list renders from _src/data/vendors.json through {{vendor_list}}: six categories in order, every one shown even when nobody is listed in it yet (Daniel: 'show a category with no act'), with the ask-us line under an empty heading. Each vendor's note is Daniel's own two sentences, never drafted here; seeding the first four to six is his research task on Signet Relaunch. Links out are dofollow and open in a new tab, which is the thing a listing gives the vendor. The join line at the foot is small and faint on purpose. Indexed; linked from the planners hub, the footer's Planning column and the weddings hub. Nothing on the page is a price, a status or a count. 2026-11-06: MXBloom Films is the first listing, one card under Photography and one under Videography, each linking to the matching page of their site; a vendor's own page on our site goes in `page`. The search title carries 'Denver wedding vendors', a phrase Google suggests; the page's name stays Preferred Vendor List.

props.title: Preferred Vendor List.
props.lede: Putting on an event means hiring six or seven people who have to work well together when the day comes. We’d love to connect you with the people we recommend to our own clients, and we keep that list short on purpose. If someone on it isn’t right for your event, we’ll tell you.

props._notes:
The buyer's page: why the list exists, what short means, what a name
     on it means. The categories and cards follow from vendors.json.

categories.label: Venues
categories.ask: Need a venue? Ask us where we’ve played, and we’ll tell you what each place is like to work with.

categories.label: Planning and coordination
categories.ask: Need someone to run the day? We’ll give you the name of a planner we’ve worked with.

categories.label: Photography
categories.ask: Looking for a photographer? We’re happy to recommend one.

categories.label: Videography
categories.ask: Want it all on video? Just ask, and we’ll send you the name of a videographer we know.

categories.label: Catering
categories.ask: Need someone to feed your guests? Let us know, and we’ll suggest a caterer.

categories.label: Design and florals
categories.ask: For flowers and decor, just reach out and we’ll point you to a designer.

vendors.name: MXBloom Films
vendors.note: Neil and Fiona are a husband-and-wife team who take bright, lovely wedding photographs across Colorado and Washington. They’re a great choice if you’d like a natural, story-driven look.

vendors.name: MXBloom Films
vendors.note: The same team makes emotional, cinematic wedding films, so you can have your photographs and your film from the same two people.

props._notes:
Six categories from vendors.json, in order, each with its cards or the
     ask-us line. Rendered by build.py vendor_list().

props.html: Work in events and want to be on this list? Here’s how to apply.

props._notes:
The way onto the list, for a vendor who lands here. Small and faint by
     design: it must never read as a second call to action beside the
     listings.

props.title: Book the music with us.
props.lede: We book live music for events of every size, from a solo musician to a full band. We’ll make sure the sound system suits the venue, and you’ll have one person to call with any questions.
